releaseNotes:
• TV guide: Favourites is now first and opens by default, and HD channels without a schedule show the standard channel's.
• Movies and TV Shows open on your Favourites row, with Cast, Genres and Director beside the banner.
• Text that doesn't fit now scrolls everywhere in the app, including full episode descriptions.
• Online subtitles: better automatic picks, and a set you choose is preferred for the rest of the show.
• Smaller tidy-ups: a divider in the Categories menus, and the seasons count is gone from the details page.
